confidence_notes: Beer, coffee and both restaurant-meal anchors come from web search results summarising Koh Lanta cost-of-living indexes (Numbeo, CityCost, Wise). These broadly agree but rest on few contributors, and Numbeo's figures look dated. Beer is also consistent with a Koh Lanta beach-bar listing at about 80 baht for a local lager. No Koh Lanta-specific cocktail or wine-by-the-glass price was found. Those two use the local beer relationship (cocktail about 1.9x beer, glass of wine about 2.2x beer), sanity-checked against scattered Krabi, Koh Samui and Koh Lipe bar prices. Baht quotes were converted to USD approximately. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge for a July low-season window. No accommodation prices were searched and no live listings were inspected. Registered-hostel supply on the island is thin, so the hostel figures are the least certain. FX is the latest RBA observation seen in search (18 Nov 2026); the 19 Nov rate was not visible.
comparable_city_reasoning: Koh Lanta is a small, relaxed Andaman-coast island in Krabi province. Food prices are benchmarked to its own index data, which sit below Phuket tourist-area levels. Drinks are cross-checked against Krabi Town, Koh Samui and Koh Lipe bar prices. Accommodation is positioned like other Krabi/Andaman beach-island destinations in the rainy low season.
